review:
The Coins game that picked up Game of the Year and Rising Star nominations at the SlotsCalendar Awards 2024. It has 20 positions and a 1,500x Grand Jackpot.

Sticky to Infinity lets Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols stay until the end of the next bonus, so the base game slowly sets up a better Hold the Jackpot round. Cash Infinity does its usual job, and Chance Level comes in three levels, 2x, 4x and 6x, making the bonus easier to reach. High volatility, 96.18% RTP. A solid entry point into the Coins series.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
